request_version_source: Android application meta-data.versionCode, not manifest versionCode

authentication.sign: HMAC-SHA1 over exact serialized UTF-8 body, lowercase hex
authentication.material: AES-GCM decrypted APK literal, key = SHA256(signer certificate DER)

cloud.expected_payload: JSON, encrypted only when written to Android private cache
cloud.metadata_version_comparison: Download when different or cache missing, not strictly greater

cache.key: Android creates a local random 32-byte key stored in SharedPreferences
cache.research_key: Ephemeral independent key, kept only during validation

selection.startup: Highest content versionCode; builtin wins equal version
selection.refresh: Only adopt when new content versionCode is strictly greater
selection.provisional: Only add IDs missing from selected official content

corrections_to_previous_research: Request versionCode is application metadata: H17006004, O17006002
H loader opcode 0xb0 is add-int/2addr: builtin effective version 117006004
O builtin effective version is17006002; package manifest versions remain unchanged
